mapper.update: update sys_paying_user set service_status = #{status} where id = #{userId}
mapper.sql: o.order_id, o.order_no, o.user_id, u.name as user_name, o.package_id, o.package_name, o.amount, o.service_times, o.rule_snapshot, o.status, o.request_key, o.paid_amount, o.payment_method, o.payment_reference, o.paid_at, o.confirmed_by, o.confirmed_at, o.cancel_reason, o.create_by, o.create_time, o.remark, e.entitlement_id, as effective_owner
from dating_order o join sys_paying_user u on u.id = o.user_id left join dating_entitlement e on e.order_id = o.order_id
mapper.select: select * from dating_order where order_id = #{orderId} for update
select * from dating_order where create_by = #{actor} and request_key = #{key}
select count(*) from dating_order where user_id = #{userId} and status = 'UNPAID'
mapper.insert: insert into dating_order (order_no, user_id, package_id, package_name, amount, service_times, rule_snapshot, status, request_key, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{orderNo}, #{userId}, #{packageId}, #{packageName}, #{amount}, #{serviceTimes}, #{ruleSnapshot}, 'UNPAID', #{requestKey}, #{createBy}, current_timestamp, #{remark})
mapper.update: update dating_order set status = 'PAID', paid_amount = #{paidAmount}, payment_method = #{paymentMethod}, payment_reference = #{paymentReference}, paid_at = #{paidAt}, confirmed_by = #{confirmedBy}, confirmed_at = current_timestamp where order_id = #{orderId} and status = 'UNPAID'
update dating_order set status = 'CANCELLED', cancel_reason = #{cancelReason}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = current_timestamp where order_id = #{orderId} and status = 'UNPAID'
mapper.select: select * from dating_entitlement where user_id = #{userId} and status = 'ACTIVE'

select ledger_id as ledgerId,entry_type as entryType,delta, balance_before as balanceBefore,balance_after as balanceAfter, pair_id as pairId,event_id as eventId,create_by as createBy,create_time as createTime from dating_entitlement_ledger where entitlement_id=#{id} order by ledger_id

select q.user_id,q.order_id,q.entitlement_id,q.code from ( select e.user_id,e.order_id,e.entitlement_id,'BALANCE_LEDGER' as code from dating_entitlement e where e.total_times != e.used_times+e.remaining_times or e.used_times < 0 or e.remaining_times < 0 or (select count(*) from dating_entitlement_ledger l where l.entitlement_id=e.entitlement_id and l.entry_type='OPEN') != 1 or e.total_times != coalesce((select sum(l.delta) from dating_entitlement_ledger l where l.entitlement_id=e.entitlement_id and l.entry_type='OPEN'),0) or e.used_times != (select count(*) from dating_entitlement_ledger l where l.entitlement_id=e.entitlement_id and l.entry_type='SERVICE_DEDUCT') or e.remaining_times != coalesce((select sum(l.delta) from dating_entitlement_ledger l where l.entitlement_id=e.entitlement_id),0) or exists(select 1 from dating_entitlement_ledger l where l.entitlement_id=e.entitlement_id and (l.user_id != e.user_id or l.order_id != e.order_id or l.balance_before+l.delta != l.balance_after or l.entry_type not in ('OPEN','SERVICE_DEDUCT') or (l.entry_type='OPEN' and (l.balance_before != 0 or l.balance_after != e.total_times)) or (l.entry_type='SERVICE_DEDUCT' and (l.delta != -1 or l.pair_id is null or l.event_id is null)) or (l.entry_type='SERVICE_DEDUCT' and l.balance_before != coalesce((select prev.balance_after from dating_entitlement_ledger prev where prev.entitlement_id=l.entitlement_id and prev.ledger_id<l.ledger_id order by prev.ledger_id desc limit 1),-1)))) union all select o.user_id,o.order_id,e.entitlement_id,'ORDER_PAYMENT' as code from dating_order o left join dating_entitlement e on e.order_id=o.order_id left join dating_payment_record p on p.order_id=o.order_id where (o.status='PAID' and (e.entitlement_id is null or p.payment_id is null or o.paid_amount is null or o.payment_method is null or o.payment_reference is null or o.paid_at is null or o.paid_amount != o.amount or p.paid_amount != o.amount or p.payment_method != o.payment_method or p.payment_reference != o.payment_reference or p.paid_at != o.paid_at or e.user_id != o.user_id or e.total_times != o.service_times or e.rule_snapshot != o.rule_snapshot)) or (o.status != 'PAID' and (e.entitlement_id is not null or p.payment_id is not null)) union all select u.id,null,null,'SERVICE_STATUS' as code from sys_paying_user u where (u.service_status='SERVING' and (select count(*) from dating_entitlement e where e.user_id=u.id and e.status='ACTIVE' and e.remaining_times>0) != 1) or (u.service_status in ('NOT_STARTED','NOT_RENEWED','SUCCESS_CLOSED') and exists(select 1 from dating_entitlement e where e.user_id=u.id and e.status='ACTIVE')) or (u.service_status='NOT_STARTED' and exists(select 1 from dating_entitlement e where e.user_id=u.id)) or (u.service_status='NOT_RENEWED' and not exists(select 1 from dating_entitlement e where e.user_id=u.id and e.status='EXHAUSTED')) or (u.service_status='SUCCESS_CLOSED' and not exists(select 1 from dating_success_case_member m where m.user_id=u.id)) or (u.service_status!='SUCCESS_CLOSED' and exists(select 1 from dating_success_case_member m where m.user_id=u.id)) or exists(select 1 from dating_entitlement e where e.user_id=u.id and ((e.status='EXHAUSTED' and e.remaining_times!=0) or (e.status='ACTIVE' and e.remaining_times<=0) or (u.service_status='SUCCESS_CLOSED' and e.status!='SUCCESS_CLOSED'))) ) q join sys_paying_user u on u.id=q.user_id where 1=1 and q.user_id=#{userId} and = #{owner} order by q.user_id,q.order_id,q.entitlement_id,q.code
mapper.insert: insert into dating_entitlement (order_id, user_id, total_times, used_times, remaining_times, status, rule_snapshot, create_by, create_time) values (#{orderId}, #{userId}, #{totalTimes}, 0, #{totalTimes}, 'ACTIVE', #{ruleSnapshot}, #{createBy}, current_timestamp)

insert into dating_payment_record (order_id, paid_amount, payment_method, payment_reference, paid_at, confirmed_by, confirmed_at, remark) values (#{orderId}, #{paidAmount}, #{paymentMethod}, #{paymentReference}, #{paidAt}, #{confirmedBy}, current_timestamp, #{remark})

insert into dating_entitlement_ledger (entitlement_id, order_id, user_id, entry_type, delta, balance_before, balance_after, create_by, create_time) values (#{entitlement.entitlementId}, #{entitlement.orderId}, #{entitlement.userId}, 'OPEN', #{entitlement.totalTimes}, 0, #{entitlement.totalTimes}, #{actor}, current_timestamp)
